title: 第3章 最多洗三天碗第4章 补全道基
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: 【无敌收徒系统：宿主双倍获得徒弟修为和感悟！】
陆玄激动了起来！
也就是说，徒弟修炼等于他修炼，徒弟感悟等于他感悟！
而且是双倍获得！
陆玄悟了。
让徒弟苦练，他躺着就行了。
扶摇啊，对不住了……
陆玄意念一动，姬扶摇的面板信息出现。
[大徒弟：姬扶摇！
境界：大玄王中期！
体质：焚天圣体（小成）！
感悟：灵火之道（小成）！
其他：道基受损，神魂受损！
这时系统的声音响起，“现在开始双倍获得姬扶摇的修为和感悟！”
瞬间，陆玄的身体僵立在原地，目瞪口呆的感受着体内的剧变。
一股无比精纯的灵能涌入了陆玄的四肢百骸，如同潮水一般冲击着他的丹田，陆玄的修为在不断暴涨。
炼气境！
玄士境！
大玄王后期！
大玄王后期大圆满！
最终，陆玄的修为稳定在玄皇境初期，体内的灵能如同江河澎湃，如同瀚海汹涌，他的黑发在狂乱舞动，皇者气机如渊似海，有一种极强的压迫感。
陆玄刚准备查看自己的身体，他的脑海中，突然出现了一些灵火之道的明悟。
灵火之道，直接大成！
他的右手缓缓摊开，一道恐怖的灵火在汹涌燃烧，不断变幻形状，随着陆玄的意念而动，无比炽烈，气势滔天！
陆玄收起灵火，脸上一阵激动。
他双倍获得了姬扶摇的修为，所以踏入了玄皇境初期！
同样，他双倍获得了姬扶摇灵火之道的感悟！
陆玄直呼系统逆天。
这还只是个开始，只要姬扶摇修为突破，有所感悟，他都会双倍获取！
现在只有姬扶摇一个徒弟，以后如果收下成千上万的徒弟，他岂不是原地起飞？
想想就有些激动！
不多时，陆玄收敛心神，看向自己的系统面板。
“宿主姓名：陆玄！
content_en:
[Invincible Disciple Recruitment System: The host gains double the disciple’s cultivation and insights! 】
Lu Xuan became excited!
In other words, the disciple's cultivation is equal to his cultivation, and his disciple's enlightenment is equal to his enlightenment!
And you get twice as much!
Lu Xuan realized.
Let the apprentice practice hard and he can just lie down.
Fuyao, I'm sorry...
Lu Xuan thought, and Ji Fuyao's panel information appeared.
[Big apprentice: Ji Fuyao!
Realm: Middle stage of Daxuan King!
Physique: Burning Heaven Holy Body (Xiao Cheng)!
Enlightenment: The Way of Spiritual Fire (Xiao Cheng)!
Others: The Dao foundation is damaged, the soul is damaged!
At this time, the system's voice sounded, "Now start doubling Ji Fuyao's cultivation and insights!"
For an instant, Lu Xuan's body froze on the spot, dumbfounded as he felt the drastic changes inside his body.
An extremely pure spiritual energy poured into Lu Xuan's limbs and bones, hitting his Dantian like a tide. Lu Xuan's cultivation level continued to skyrocket.
Qi refining realm!
Xuanshi realm!
…
The late stage of King Daxuan!
Great Consummation in the later period of King Daxuan!
In the end, Lu Xuan's cultivation stabilized at the early stage of the Xuanhuang Realm. The spiritual energy in his body was like a surging river, like a turbulent sea. His black hair was dancing wildly, and the emperor's energy was like an abyss or a sea, giving him a strong sense of oppression.
Just as Lu Xuan was about to check his body, some enlightenment about the way of spiritual fire suddenly appeared in his mind.
The way of spiritual fire is directly accomplished!
His right hand slowly spread out, and a terrifying spiritual fire was burning fiercely, constantly changing its shape, moving with Lu Xuan's thoughts, extremely fierce and powerful!
Lu Xuan put away the spiritual fire, with excitement on his face.
He has doubled Ji Fuyao's cultivation, so he has entered the early stage of the Xuanhuang Realm!
Likewise, he gained double the understanding of Ji Fuyao's spiritual fire method!
Lu Xuan called the system defiant.
This is just the beginning. As long as Ji Fuyao breaks through in cultivation and has some insights, he will get double the amount!
Now Ji Fuyao only has one disciple. If he accepts thousands of disciples in the future, wouldn't he just take off from the same spot?
Just thinking about it makes me a little excited!
After a while, Lu Xuan gathered his thoughts and looked at his system panel.
"Host name: Lu Xuan!
